name: OpenTopoMap
tagline: Free topographic map tiles from OSM and SRTM elevation data
description: OpenTopoMap is a free topographic map tile service that renders OpenStreetMap data with SRTM elevation into classic contour-style map tiles. Developers typically load XYZ raster tiles at zoom levels for outdoor, hiking, and terrain-focused maps.

auth.details: No API key required for public tile usage. Usage is subject to fair-use and attribution requirements on the project site.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Public free tile access; no published paid plans. Respect fair-use limits from the project.

example.response_snippet: HTTP 200 OK; Content-Type: image/png; binary PNG raster tile saved as tile.png.

use_cases: load topographic base map tiles in a web map
show hiking terrain with contour-style basemap
add outdoor-oriented OSM tiles to a mobile map view
prefetch XYZ topo tiles for offline cache
